@jikunshang I have exact same version `mistral_common   1.5.1` and `tiktoken   0.7.0`
@jikunshang  Another thing to mention is that, this is happening only for few mistral models only.
@vijaypal89 thanks for your input, fixed in this PR https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/12149 please take a try.
Thanks @jikunshang this fixes vllm issue `TypeError: argument 'text': 'list' object cannot be converted to 'PyString'`

review_comments:
```suggestion
        input_ids: List[int]
        # For List[str], original prompt text
```

Provide type annotation to avoid type errors
`input_ids` may be `List[List[int]]`(prompt type is `List[str]`) or `List[int]` (prompt type is `str` or `List[int]`). updated, please take a review again.
From my understanding, `transformers.BatchEncoding` expects `input_ids` to always be a nested list (`List[List[int]]`). I think we should normalize this even for a single input prompt.

usages in benchmark_serving.py require both nested list(batch decode https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/benchmarks/benchmark_serving.py#L149) and list(single chat template https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/benchmarks/benchmark_serving.py#L161). maybe we can unify usage first?
I see, then let's keep this as is then.
